articles.title: The Winter Olympics opening ceremony is here and how ICE agents are scanning people's faces: Morning Rundown
articles.summary: Today's newsletter previews the Winter Olympics opening ceremony, marking the official start of the Games. It also discusses the controversial deployment of facial scanning technology by immigration agents for tracking both specific targets and general bystanders, raising significant concerns about privacy and surveillance implications.

articles.title: IndiGo plans to launch Delhi-Shanghai flight
articles.summary: IndiGo is set to launch direct flights connecting New Delhi and Shanghai, becoming the third airline to operate services between India and China since air travel resumed. This move aims to enhance connectivity and facilitate easier travel, strengthening bilateral ties between the two nations by improving accessibility for passengers and businesses.

articles.title: Telco trio launches African cross-border fibre project
articles.summary: Three African telecom operators have launched a cross-border optical fibre project to significantly boost digital connectivity across East and Northeast Africa. This strategic partnership aims to enhance internet access and data transmission capabilities, fostering economic growth and regional integration by creating robust digital infrastructure across multiple nations.

articles.title: How India is gearing up to power its AI ambitions
articles.summary: India's ambitious Artificial Intelligence (AI) roadmap critically depends on robust energy infrastructure. Sustainable and reliable power is essential to support the massive data centres and digital networks required for AI development and deployment. This foundational energy backbone is vital for enabling large-scale AI initiatives nationwide, ensuring India's technological advancement and strategic capabilities in this crucial sector.

articles.title: More Navy sailors gain access to Headspace mental health therapy, coaching program
articles.summary: The U.S. Navy is enhancing mental health support for its personnel, demonstrating a growing emphasis on well-being within the armed forces. Sailors at Yokosuka Naval Base, Japan, were introduced to the Headspace app, a mental health care tool. This expansion signifies the Navy's commitment to providing accessible resources, crucial for operational readiness and overall welfare of service members globally.

articles.title: Zhang Youxia: veteran princeling caught in China's military purge
articles.summary: China's announcement of an investigation into its top general has stunned global defence watchers, significantly weakening the country's senior military leadership. This development further highlights President Xi Jinping's ongoing anti-corruption drive and efforts to consolidate power within the People's Liberation Army. The probe raises questions regarding stability and future strategic direction within China's armed forces and leadership.
